name: Top 10 Net Return
sub: Rank by total cumulative $ net return across all closed positions.

name: Top 10 Alt Net Return
sub: Rank by counterfactual Alt Net Return ($ alt_net_return) across simulated positions.

name: Top 10 Win Rate
sub: Rank by highest percentage of winning trades (min 50% win rate).

name: Find the Strongest Three
sub: Top 3 highest momentum performers over recent trade windows.

name: Explore a Strengthening Cluster
sub: Top performers within the active breakout_R cluster (Range-bound filters).

name: Find Relative Value in a Cluster
sub: High win-rate strategies (≥85%) offering controlled stop loss risk.

name: Match the Current Market Move
sub: Aggressive trend-following breakouts with TP ≥ 10 pips.

name: Look at an Opposite Cluster
sub: High-frequency micro-scalpers (TP 3–5 pips) for orthogonal risk comparison.

name: Review a Weakening Selection
sub: High-volume strategies experiencing drawdown to examine reversal points.

name: Repair a Negative Selection
sub: Elite replacement candidates with 100% win rate and positive net yield.
